title: HuMeta
full_title: Social Science, Humanities, and Education Study Metadata Profile

obligations.M: Mandatory: every record must have it.
obligations.MA: Mandatory if applicable: required when the stated condition holds.

humeta.name: HuMeta profile (element or vocabulary defined by this profile)

fos.name: OECD Fields of Science and Technology (FOS), as used by DataCite

nces_locale.name: NCES locale classification (locale types City, Suburb, Town, Rural)

isced.name: UNESCO International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011)

testing_standards.name: Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing (2014)

common_rule.name: US Common Rule for human-subjects research (45 CFR 46)

ferpa.name: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (34 CFR Part 99)

care.name: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance

local_contexts.name: Local Contexts Traditional Knowledge and Biocultural Labels and Notices

aoir.name: Association of Internet Researchers, Internet Research: Ethical Guidelines 3.0 (2019)

core.label: Core
core.definition: Elements for any study in the social sciences, humanities, or education.

education.label: Education
education.definition: Optional module for studies in education settings: learners' education levels, institutions and instructional settings. Its mandatory elements apply only when a record includes the module.

elements.label: Title
elements.definition: Name of the resource.

elements.label: Creators
elements.definition: People or organizations primarily responsible for the resource, with ORCID iDs where available.

elements.label: Publisher
elements.definition: Entity that holds, archives, or makes the resource available (usually the repository or institution).

elements.label: Publication year
elements.definition: Year the resource was or will be made publicly available.

elements.label: Resource type
elements.definition: General type of the resource, using DataCite resourceTypeGeneral values.

elements.label: Identifier
elements.definition: Persistent identifier (DOI preferred) once one has been assigned.

elements.label: Description
elements.definition: Abstract or summary of the resource.

elements.label: Keywords
elements.definition: Free-text keywords.

elements.label: Language
elements.definition: Primary language of the resource (BCP 47 code, e.g. en).

elements.label: License
elements.definition: License for the resource, as an SPDX identifier where possible (e.g. CC-BY-4.0).

elements.label: Funding
elements.definition: Funders and award numbers.

elements.label: Data collection dates
elements.definition: Start and end of data collection (ISO 8601 dates).

elements.label: Geographic coverage
elements.definition: Countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and, for the US, states (USPS codes) where data were collected.

elements.label: Related resources
elements.definition: Related publications, datasets, preregistrations, or instruments, with a DataCite relationType.

elements.label: Research field
elements.definition: Broad field(s) the study belongs to: education, social sciences, humanities, arts, or other. Interdisciplinary studies choose several.
elements.datacite: subjects (subjectScheme 'Fields of Science and Technology (FOS)', e.g. 'FOS: Educational sciences')

elements.label: Topic / content domain
elements.definition: The main subject or topic of the study, in the researcher's words (e.g., 'introductory geology lab learning').

elements.label: Research questions and aims
elements.definition: Primary research questions, objectives, or hypotheses.

elements.label: Unit of analysis
elements.definition: The unit(s) the analysis is about: people, groups, places, texts, images, objects, and so on.

elements.label: Sampling procedure
elements.definition: How cases (people, texts, objects, sites) were selected.

elements.label: Constructs measured
elements.condition: Mandatory when resource_type is Dataset or Instrument.
elements.definition: Constructs measured, from the HuMeta construct vocabulary (library/constructs.json), optionally with the instrument, version and subscale used.
elements.datacite: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Constructs', valueURI per construct); for datasets, relatedIdentifiers to the instrument's library record (URL, relationType IsCollectedBy) and its publication (DOI, relationType References); ERIC descriptors as additional subjects

elements.label: Discipline or subject area
elements.definition: Discipline(s) or subject area(s) of the study; for education studies, the subject taught or learned.
elements.datacite: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Disciplines'; plus 'Fields of Science and Technology (FOS)' with each term's FOS code)

elements.label: Human participants
elements.definition: Whether people take part in the study directly, are its subject only indirectly (records, public posts), or are not involved (texts, artworks, objects only).

elements.label: Participant population
elements.definition: Who the participants, or the people the data are about, are.
elements.condition: Mandatory when human participants is direct or indirect.

elements.label: Education level
elements.definition: Education level(s) of the participants.
elements.datacite: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Education Levels'); ISCED 2011 level as an additional subject (subjectScheme 'ISCED 2011')

alignments.note: Options 0–8 are the ISCED 2011 levels; adult and informal learning are HuMeta additions outside ISCED.
Dublin Core's educationLevel describes the audience a resource is intended for; this element describes the participants studied.
schema.org's educationalLevel describes the level a resource is designed for; this element describes the participants studied.

elements.label: Undergraduate course level
elements.definition: Course level(s) for undergraduate studies.

elements.label: Population description
elements.definition: Narrative description of the participants and sampling, without identifying information.

elements.label: Sample size
elements.definition: Number of participants (or units) in the data.

elements.label: Institution type
elements.definition: Type(s) of institution or organization.

elements.label: Locale
elements.definition: Community type(s) where the study took place.

elements.label: Instructional modality
elements.definition: How instruction or participation was delivered.

elements.label: Learning environment
elements.definition: Instructional setting(s).

elements.label: Instructional approach
elements.definition: Instructional approach(es) used or studied.

alignments.note: Dublin Core's instructionalMethod describes the teaching method a resource is designed to support; this element describes the approach used or studied in the research.

elements.label: Study design
elements.condition: Mandatory when resource_type is Dataset or StudyRegistration.
elements.definition: Design(s) that produced the evidence.

elements.label: Measurement evidence
elements.definition: Kinds of reliability and validity evidence the resource provides.

elements.label: Data collection method
elements.definition: How data or sources were gathered.

elements.label: Analysis method
elements.definition: How the data or sources were analyzed: statistical, qualitative, interpretive, or computational.

elements.label: Source type
elements.condition: Mandatory when human participants is none.
elements.definition: Kinds of sources studied other than data collected from participants: texts, archival records, images, artworks, media, online content, objects, existing datasets.

elements.label: Sources description
elements.definition: The corpus, collection, or set of sources: what it includes and how it was selected.

elements.label: Holding institutions or platforms
elements.definition: Where the sources are held: archives, libraries, museums, collections, or platforms.

elements.label: Time period of sources
elements.definition: The period the sources cover or were created in (e.g., 1850-1900, 19th century), as distinct from when data were collected.

elements.label: Rights status of sources
elements.definition: Copyright or other rights status of the sources, which decides whether copies of them can be shared.

elements.label: Human-subjects review
elements.definition: Ethics / IRB review status, as reported by the researcher.

elements.label: Participation consent
elements.definition: How participants agreed to take part.

elements.label: Consent for data sharing
elements.definition: What participants allow regarding sharing beyond the research team.

elements.label: Identifiability
elements.definition: Identifiability of the data.

elements.label: Sensitivity flags
elements.definition: Kinds of sensitive information in the underlying data.

elements.label: Online data practices
elements.condition: Mandatory when the study uses social media or website sources, or web or platform data collection.
elements.definition: How content from websites, social media, or other platforms was collected and handled: public or private spaces, platform terms, consent, and protection of authors.

elements.label: Access level
elements.definition: How the data can be accessed.

elements.label: Governance notes
elements.definition: Approval references, data-use restrictions, retention or de-identification requirements (no confidential details).

elements.label: Indigenous data
elements.definition: Whether the resource contains or derives from data about Indigenous Peoples, nations, communities, lands, territories, or knowledges.

elements.label: Indigenous data governance
elements.definition: How Indigenous authority to control the data is exercised (CARE: Authority to control).

elements.label: CARE statement
elements.definition: How the work provides collective benefit, respects authority to control, and meets responsibility and ethics obligations to the communities involved.

elements.label: Local Contexts project
elements.definition: URL of a Local Contexts Hub project holding Traditional Knowledge or Biocultural Labels or Notices for this resource.

elements.label: Local Contexts Labels and Notices
elements.definition: Names of Local Contexts Labels or Notices applied by the community (e.g. 'TK Attribution').

rules.message: Instruments, and datasets from studies with human participants, must list at least one construct measured.
Datasets and study registrations must list at least one study design.
Instruments must list at least one kind of measurement evidence.
Open access requires data that are de-identified, anonymous, aggregate-only, synthetic, or not participant data.
Open access requires consent for broad sharing (or no human-subjects data).
Data cannot be open or registered-access while human-subjects review is 'not yet assessed' or 'pending'.
Indigenous data require a governance arrangement and a CARE statement.
Indigenous data may be open only under a community data governance agreement or tribal review approval.
Data from education records (FERPA): confirm the institution's FERPA review before any sharing.
Indigenous data status is unknown; assess it before sharing.
A specific community or a tribal college is involved; confirm whether the data are Indigenous data.
Direct identifiers are flagged; they must be removed before the data are shared.
Public online posts can identify their authors through search even after names are removed. Before sharing, remove usernames and alter quotes, or share only post IDs.
Confirm that collecting and sharing online content follows the platform's terms of service or a data-access agreement.
Online content may come from minors; review whether it can be shared, and with whom.
Content from closed or semi-private online spaces usually needs authors' consent or ethics-review approval, because users there expect privacy.
Sources are in copyright or not yet evaluated: share metadata, citations, or derived data rather than copies unless the rights allow it.

match_types.exact: Same meaning; values can be copied directly.
match_types.close: Near-equivalent; usable interchangeably in most cases.
